front.title: A Method for Reproducible Review of Internet-Draft Test Cases

abstract.t: This document describes MiMS, a method for an author and independent reviewers to identify an exact Internet-Draft revision, reproduce a bounded technical proposition, and trace a finding to a subsequent edit and replay. It distinguishes evidence of package delivery, evidence of independent computation, and evidence of editorial disposition. A SCITT-related example demonstrates the scope of a reproducible finding. The method is usable with existing transports and independently chosen verification tools.
